## [1.5.1](https://github.com/awinogradov/code-assistants/compare/release-action@v1.5.0...release-action@v1.5.1) (2026-10-08)

## Release Notes

The publish phase in a monorepo now reads the member package's `package.json` instead of the workspace root, unblocking releases where the root package name is not a valid npm identifier.

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Monorepo releases no longer abort when the workspace root `package.json` carries a name that is not a valid npm package name — the action now reads the member package's `package.json` throughout the create phase.
- The create phase no longer generates a spurious empty `CHANGELOG.md` at the repository root during a monorepo release.
